Hi,

I'm currently trying to get from the seqz file generated by the VarScan2seqz function and onwards.

I get the

Error in pipe(paste("cut -f 1,6,10", file)) :
  invalid 'description' argument

When I try to run the

sequenza.extract function on my seqz file. I currently do not have acces to other files than the snp, and raw CG file generated by VarScan2.

What could be done to avoid this? Have removed all bugs uptil now, and my chromosomes are 1-22 and x and y only.

Best

Nicolai

messages.subject: Re: pileup2seqz: -C / --chromosome options (just as for bam2seqz)
messages.body_plain:
Hi Francesco,

I created the pileup file chromosome by chromosome. Then, is it ok to run pileup2seqz for each of these files independently?
Best
Winnie

Francesco Favero於 2015年4月20日星期一 UTC+8上午3時38分20秒寫道：

> Hi Henrik,
>
> Unfortunately only the bam2seqz implement the lookup by coordinate feature. This because it uses the "samtools view" options.
>
> It is possible however tocreate a binary index of a pileup with tabix, and then query a given position in a similar way then samtools does.
>
> I'm not going to implement in the near future this functionality out of the box in pileup2seqz, but it's possible to use the command in pipes with others. So it is already possible to achieve a similar result.
> I suggest to use named pipes (fifo files) if you want to try it. If you need help I will try to set up an example that you can follow
>
> Best
>
> Francesco

> On 8 Apr 2015 04:45, "Henrik Bengtsson" <henrik.b...@gmail.com> wrote:

> > Hi,
> >

However, as far as I understand this option is only available for bam2seqz, or?
